newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa stocks end touch weaker as golds slide.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa stocks end touch weaker as golds slide.

text.p: South African shares ended the week a touch softer depressed by losses in gold stocks as bullion dipped below the $382 level in the wake of weakness in silver, dealers said.
The local gold index ended down 21 points at 1,737.9.

Industrial shares shrugged off early morning weakness, climbing into positive territory towards the close on some fresh local interest in select stocks and early gains on Wall Street on Friday, dealers said.
The local industrial index ended 14.8 points stronger at 8,190.8 with the overall index four points down at 6,935.3.
Overall trading on the day was, however, lacklustre and thin as many players took a long weekend ahead of Monday's Jewish holiday and Tuesday's national public holiday.
